sources.title: Adaptive Linear Path Model-Based Diffusion
sources.review_notes: All 8 pages reviewed against page renders by one reviewer agent (reports/review-pages-0001-0008.md): equations (1a)-(22) and inline maths transcribed to LaTeX from the authors' TeX and compared with 220 dpi crops; Figures 1-6 checked on all four edges; Algorithm 1 kept as a crop with a line-numbered transcription; Tables I-II checked cell by cell; references [1]-[41] checked character by character, [24] moved after [23], split URLs rejoined. Verifier diagnostics on pages 2-8 are LaTeX-notation, minus-glyph, algorithm-transcription, glued table cells (second parser) and one rejoined DOI, adjudicated per page.
